content: Supabase Auth session config: auth.autoRefreshToken (auto-refresh before expiry), auth.persistSession (save session to storage, default localStorage in browser), auth.detectSessionInUrl (OAuth grant detection). Access tokens are short-lived JWTs (5min-1hr), refresh tokens are single-use and exchanged for new pairs. For PWAs use PKCE flow (default in supabase-js v2) rather than implicit flow. Known offline/PWA gap: setSession()/getSession() can trigger a network call on init even when a valid cached session exists in storage, which can falsely sign out users who open the PWA offline -- active community-reported limitation, workaround is checking storage directly on boot before relying on the SDK's async getSession(). Source: supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/sessions + community discussions.
